title: nncg: Non-Negative Conjugate Gradients
description:
nncg solves the strictly convex non-negative quadratic program minx ≥ 0 1/2 x'Ax - b'x with A symmetric positive definite, and its equality-augmented variant Bx = c, by wrapping matrix-free conjugate gradients in a primal-dual active-set loop.

The working-set toggles are the principal pivots of the linear complementarity problem LCP(A, -b); guarding the fast block-pivot path with a least-index Bland fallback gives unconditional finite termination at the unique global minimiser, with no non-degeneracy assumption. The package also ships MPRGP (Dostál & Schöberl) as a first-order, factorisation-free alternative on the same bound-constrained problem.

This is the reference implementation of the paper Non-Negative Conjugate Gradients (Schmelzer & Stoll); its test suite is the paper's numerical study.
